items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: several members of the Wolverines were there already. ... Victor Moore was setting up his drums. ... There was Jimmy Hartwell, Bobby Gillette, Dick Bono.

ctx.x: i'd say a quiet type person like bix was did you and bix have any kind of a relationship that is to say that bix knew you as a certain kind of person or would joke with you that way or that kind of thing

or you kind of had a rapport some kind of rapport well one of the things that makes me so unhappy is we all had pictures individual pictures taken when we had that last picture of the woman taken in new order and we all had individual pictures and um i gave him mine autograph he gave me his autograph talking about the rhythm what a terrific rhythm and the whole heck that beat and all that kind of stuff and i'd give anything if i had something that's gone someplace else yeah but that's not just one of these…
